name: decision-pack
title: Feedback decision pack
for_each: select id,title as name from feedback.ideas

sections.title: Verified account evidence
sections.sql: select a.name,a.currency,a.mrr,s.evidence from feedback.support s join feedback.accounts a on a.id=s.account_id where s.idea_id=$1

sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: select actor,body,created_at from feedback.notes where idea_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Account
sections.sql: select name,currency,mrr,renewal_on from feedback.accounts where id=$1

sections.title: Promises and evidence
sections.sql: select i.title,i.status,p.due_on,p.owner,p.state,p.evidence from feedback.promises p join feedback.ideas i on i.id=p.idea_id where p.account_id=$1 order by p.due_on
